title: The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates
summary: Prescribes how to include foreign currency transactions and foreign operations in an entity's financial statements, and how to translate financial statements into a presentation currency. Covers determining functional currency, recognizing exchange differences, translating foreign operations, and disposal effects, including the advance-consideration Appendix.
description: IPSAS 4 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates prescribes how to include foreign currency transactions and foreign operations in an entity's financial statements, and how to translate financial statements into a presentation currency. Principal issues are (a) which exchange rate(s) to use and (b) how to report the effects of changes in foreign exchange rates, including the Appendix on advance consideration.
aliases: The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates
